original: nāmaikameva tatvaṃ tad dṛḍhaṃ dhāraya re manaḥ|
analyzed: nāma ekam eva tat dṛḍham dhāraya re manaḥ
kāruṇya bhāvaḥ jāyeta tena tvad viṣaye harau

original: suvācaṃ nāma tad rāma kṛṣṇa govinda vāpi ca|
analyzed: su vācam nāma tat rāma kṛṣṇa govinda vā api ca

original: vāṇyā sagadgadaṃ nāma tadeva prathamaṃ japa||2
analyzed: vāṇyā sa gadgadam nāma tat eva prathamam japa

original: nāmnaḥ parataraṃ tatvaṃ vidyate naiva cāparam|
analyzed: nāmnaḥ parataram vidyate na eva ca aparam
atas ca anyena mārgeṇa gamanam te nirarthakam
jñāneśaḥ vakti mūkaḥ sandhṛtvā śrī harim antare

original: kṛtvā ca manaso mālāṃ hṛdi nityaṃ japāmyaham||4
analyzed: kṛtvā ca manasaḥ mālām hṛdi nityam japāmi aham
atas ūrdhva ghaṭikām vā api mā nāma vimukhaḥ bhava
saṃsāra vyavahāraḥ usau mithyā asti sakalaḥ api ca

original: gatāgataṃ vṛthā tatra harināma vinā bhavet||2
analyzed: gatāgatam vṛthā tatra hari nāma vinā bhavet
nāma mantra japena eva koṭi pāpa vināśanam
rāmakṛṣṇa jape tasmāt saṅkalpaḥ te dṛḍhaḥ bhavet

original: samāvṛṇu nijāṃ vṛttiṃ māyāṃ troṭaya cākhilām|
analyzed: samāvṛṇu nijām vṛttim māyām troṭaya ca akhilām
indriya anunayāt mā svam gopaya asmāt śamāt damāt

original: kāryā tīrthe vrate śraddhā, śāntyā karuṇayā tathā|
analyzed: kāryā tīrthe vrate śraddhā śāntyā karuṇayā tathā
dayayā ca eva satkāryaḥ hariḥ prāhuṇikaḥ tvayā
jñāneśasya pramāṇam tat jñānam uktam nivṛttinā
saṃjīvana samādhiḥ sa hari pāṭhena siddhi ati
bhavanti haripāṭhe ismin padyānām ekaviṃśatiḥ
viśvasya nāma sāmarthye jñāneśa racitāni ca
indrāyaṇī nadī tīre nityam paṭhati yaḥ naraḥ
tatas tasya adhikāraḥ ca sarvathā jāyate dhruvam
ekāgra manasā ca eva svastha cittena sādhakaḥ
sa ullāsam ca tathā kuryāt nāma smaraṇam antare
jīvanasya antime kāle saṅkaṭeṣu tathā eva ca
bahis ca eva antare ca eva nibhālayati tān hariḥ
anubhūtam idam na ekaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sat janaiḥ tathā

original: yaścālaso mandabuddhiḥ sa kathaṃ nu tarennaraḥ||5
analyzed: yaḥ ca alasaḥ manda buddhiḥ sa katham nu taret naraḥ
nivṛtti sat guroḥ etat śrutvā prema yutam vacaḥ
anukṣaṇam jñānadevaḥ santoṣam param āptavān
